name: Disable Delivery Optimization
description: Disables Windows Delivery Optimization to stop background sharing and downloading of update data, which can reduce network activity.

description_i18n.en: Disables Windows Delivery Optimization to stop background sharing and downloading of update data, which can reduce network activity.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die Windows-Lieferoptimierung, um Hintergrundfreigabe und Download von Update-Daten zu stoppen sowie Netzwerkaktivität zu reduzieren.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive l'Optimisation de livraison de Windows pour arrêter le partage et le téléchargement en arrière-plan des données de mise à jour.

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the registry key HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization by setting or removing the DODownloadMode value
